items.headline: Fortum Stock And the Sand Battery Shift Investors Need To Watch
items.snippet: Albemarle sits in a tough spot for this thermal storage transition. It is tightly linked to lithium demand from batteries just as sand based systems and other non lithium options start to attract attention as cheaper, simpler ways to back up renewables.
